name: Wholetech System Hitech Limited
summary: Wholetech System Hitech Limited provides system integration services in Taiwan, China, Japan, and Singapore. It operates through Construction and Equipment segments. The company offers semiconductors, pipelines, chemical equipment, chemical supply, chemical polishing liquid, gas exhaust, waste, gas treatment, and automatic control equipment, as well as trades and sells equipment products and mechanical parts.
